name: Tortured Sentinel drops Breastplate of Shattered Honor via equipped gear loot (#13704)
contract: Requires CoA.Enable=1, CoA.EquippedGearLoot=1 and CoA.EquippedGearLootChance=5 (shipped defaults).
Tortured Sentinel (12179, levels 56-57, Physical, CreatureDisplayInfo 12270 -> CreatureDisplayInfoExtra 3045)
wears Sentinel plate in six armor slots: head 145103, shoulders 146028, chest 3511, legs 152490, feet 154680
and hands 157132. No item_template row uses DisplayInfoID 3511 directly, but ItemDisplayInfo.dbc gives 3511
the exact same models, geosets and armor textures (Plate_B_03Sentinel_Sleeve_AU, Plate_B_03Sentinel_Chest_TU,
Plate_B_03Sentinel_Chest_TL) as 147451 (Breastplate of Shattered Honor 2062669, RequiredLevel 56, ItemLevel 61,
Strength/Stamina), which the 2026-09-13 exiles-db creature_loot export records on entry 12179 alongside the
With visual-twin fallback in AscensionEquippedGearLoot, 5000 corpse-loot rolls (5% chance across 7 worn slots,
~0.71% per piece, P(0 hits) < 1e-15) must drop Breastplate of Shattered Honor (2062669) alongside existing
exact-display pieces (2060201, 2072384) and never drop out-of-band twin Corrupted Arbor Plate (2063780, req 58).
